changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A monitored resource stores only the visibility classes that the server reads.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE repository_to_monitor ADD CONSTRAINT ck_repository_to_monitor_visibility_class CHECK (visibility_class IN ('WORKSPACE', 'RESTRICTED', 'UNPROVEN'))
ALTER TABLE outline_collection ADD CONSTRAINT ck_outline_collection_visibility_class CHECK (visibility_class IN ('WORKSPACE', 'RESTRICTED', 'UNPROVEN'))
ALTER TABLE slack_monitored_channel ADD CONSTRAINT ck_slack_monitored_channel_visibility_class CHECK (visibility_class IN ('WORKSPACE', 'RESTRICTED', 'UNPROVEN'))

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE outline_collection DROP CONSTRAINT ck_outline_collection_visibility_class
ALTER TABLE repository_to_monitor DROP CONSTRAINT ck_repository_to_monitor_visibility_class

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Cutover: a monitored repository that its provider confirmed public in the last 48 hours, as public activity requires, is visible to the whole workspace. Every other resource stays UNPROVEN until its readers are proven.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE repository_to_monitor rtm SET visibility_class = 'WORKSPACE' WHERE rtm.unavailable_since IS NULL AND rtm.repository_visibility_confirmed_at > now() - interval '48 hours' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM repository r WHERE rtm.native_id = r.native_id AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM connection monitor_connection JOIN identity_provider monitor_provider ON monitor_provider.type = monitor_connection.kind AND monitor_provider.server_url = monitor_connection.config ->> 'serverUrl' WHERE monitor_connection.kind IN ('GITHUB', 'GITLAB') AND monitor_connection.state IN ('ACTIVE', 'SUSPENDED') AND monitor_connection.workspace_id = rtm.workspace_id AND monitor_provider.id = r.provider_id) AND r.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND NOT r.is_private)
